import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

public class Main {
    static final int MODULUS_CONST = 998244353;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] inputValues1 = new int[3];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            inputValues1[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        int[] inputValues2 = new int[3];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            inputValues2[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        int rock1 = inputValues1[0], sci1 = inputValues1[1], paper1 = inputValues1[2];
        int rock2 = inputValues2[0], sci2 = inputValues2[1], paper2 = inputValues2[2];

        int maxPoints = Math.min(rock1, sci2) + Math.min(sci1, paper2) + Math.min(paper1, rock2);
        int minScore = findMin(rock1, sci1, paper1, rock2, sci2, paper2);
        System.out.println(minScore + " " + maxPoints);
        sc.close();
    }

    static int maxPoints(int rock1, int sci1, int paper1, int rock2, int sci2, int paper2) {
        return Math.min(rock1, sci2) + Math.min(sci1, paper2) + Math.min(paper1, rock2);
    }

    static int matchType(int a, int b) {
        if (a == b) {
            return 0;
        } else if ((a == 1 && b == 2) || (a == 2 && b == 3) || (a == 3 && b == 1)) {
            return 1;
        } else {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    static int evaluate(List<int[]> l1, List<int[]> l2) {
        int totalScore = 0;
        int c1 = 0, c2 = 0;
        while (!l1.isEmpty() || !l2.isEmpty()) {
            if (c1 == 0 && !l1.isEmpty()) {
                c1 = l1.remove(l1.size() - 1)[0];
            }
            if (c2 == 0 && !l2.isEmpty()) {
                c2 = l2.remove(l2.size() - 1)[0];
            }
            if (c1 == 0 || c2 == 0) {
                break;
            }
            int minVal = Math.min(c1, c2);
            int score = Math.max(0, minVal * matchType(l1.get(l1.size() - 1)[1], l2.get(l2.size() - 1)[1]));
            totalScore += score;
            if (c1 < c2) {
                c2 -= c1;
                c1 = 0;
            } else if (c1 > c2) {
                c1 -= c2;
                c2 = 0;
            } else {
                c1 = c2 = 0;
            }
        }
        return totalScore;
    }

    static int findMin(int rock1, int sci1, int paper1, int rock2, int sci2, int paper2) {
        List<int[]> perms1 = generatePermutations(new int[][] {
            {rock1, 1},
            {sci1, 2},
            {paper1, 3}
        });
        List<int[]> perms2 = generatePermutations(new int[][] {
            {rock2, 1},
            {sci2, 2},
            {paper2, 3}
        });
        int answer = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        for (int[] p1 : perms1) {
            for (int[] p2 : perms2) {
                List<int[]> p1Copy = deepCopy(p1);
                List<int[]> p2Copy = deepCopy(p2);
                answer = Math.min(answer, evaluate(p1Copy, p2Copy));
            }
        }
        return answer;
    }

    static List<int[]> generatePermutations(int[][] array) {
        List<int[]> permutations = new ArrayList<>();
        permute(array, 0, permutations);
        return permutations;
    }

    static void permute(int[][] array, int start, List<int[]> permutations) {
        if (start == array.length - 1) {
            int[] perm = new int[array.length * 2];
            for (int i = 0; i < array.length; i++) {
                perm[2 * i] = array[i][0];
                perm[2 * i + 1] = array[i][1];
            }
            permutations.add(perm);
            return;
        }
        for (int i = start; i < array.length; i++) {
            swap(array, start, i);
            permute(array, start + 1, permutations);
            swap(array, start, i);
        }
    }

    static void swap(int[][] array, int i, int j) {
        int[] temp = array[i];
        array[i] = array[j];
        array[j] = temp;
    }

    static List<int[]> deepCopy(int[] array) {
        List<int[]> copy = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < array.length; i += 2) {
            copy.add(new int[] {array[i], array[i + 1]});
        }
        return copy;
    }
}
